msg: Cluster "{name}" is on the Extended channel with GKE {minor}, which left standard support on {eos}. Since then Google bills the extended period cluster management fee: $0.50 per cluster per hour on top of the $0.10 cluster management fee ($0.60 in total). The full extended period for {minor} ({eos} to {eoe}, {pdays} days) is {pfee} per cluster; from {today} to {eoe} it is {rfee}.
fix: Upgrade min_master_version to a minor still in standard support (for example {next}); every hour left on {minor} adds $0.50, or {rfee} if the cluster stays until {eoe}.

msg: Cluster "{name}" is on the Extended channel with GKE {minor}. Standard support ends on {eos} ({days} days after {today}); from that day Google adds $0.50 per cluster per hour ($0.60 in total). The full extended period for {minor} ({eos} to {eoe}, {pdays} days) is {pfee} per cluster.
fix: Plan the minor upgrade before {eos}, or record the {pfee} per cluster in the budget.

msg: Cluster "{name}" runs GKE {minor}, whose extended support ends on {eoe} ({days} days after {today}). Around 2 months before that date GKE begins upgrading Extended channel clusters to the next minor, and at the end of extended support it upgrades every cluster still on {minor} regardless of blocking issues. Maintenance exclusions can't be set past that date.
fix: Test and run the upgrade to {next} yourself before {eoe}, so it happens in your maintenance window, not Google's.

msg: Resource "{name}" pins GKE {minor}. {minor} is past the end of extended support ({eoe}) on the GKE release schedule; GKE upgrades clusters still running an unsupported minor regardless of blocking issues, so this pin no longer describes the live cluster.
fix: Set the version to a supported minor (for example {next}) and review deprecated APIs before apply.

msg: Cluster "{name}" pins GKE {minor} on the {channel} channel. {minor} left standard support on {eos}; only the Extended channel keeps a minor past end of standard support, so on {channel} GKE auto-upgrades this cluster.
fix: Upgrade to {next}, or move to channel = "EXTENDED" knowing it costs $0.50 per cluster per hour after end of standard support.

msg: Cluster "{name}" sets release_channel to UNSPECIFIED ("No channel"). GKE lists this configuration option as deprecated and says it will be removed on June 14, 2027.
fix: Enroll the cluster in REGULAR, STABLE or EXTENDED before June 14, 2027.

msg: Cluster "{name}" sets enable_autopilot = true with channel = "EXTENDED". GKE's limitations list says Autopilot cluster mode can't be enrolled in the Extended channel.
fix: Use REGULAR or STABLE for Autopilot, or a Standard cluster for long-term support.

msg: Cluster "{name}" sets enable_kubernetes_alpha = true with channel = "EXTENDED". Alpha clusters can't be enrolled in the Extended channel.
fix: Remove enable_kubernetes_alpha, or put the alpha cluster on the RAPID channel.

msg: Cluster "{name}" has an enable_k8s_beta_apis block with channel = "EXTENDED". Clusters with explicitly-enabled Kubernetes beta APIs can't be enrolled in the Extended channel.
fix: Remove enable_k8s_beta_apis before enrolling in EXTENDED, or keep the cluster on REGULAR.

msg: Cluster "{name}" enables config_connector_config with channel = "EXTENDED". Config Connector is on GKE's list of features that can't be used in the Extended channel.
fix: Run Config Connector on a cluster in REGULAR or STABLE, or disable it here.

msg: Node pool "{name}" uses image_type {image} on cluster "{cluster}", which is on channel = "EXTENDED". Windows Server node pools can't be used in the Extended channel.
fix: Move Windows workloads to a cluster on REGULAR or STABLE.

msg: Cluster "{name}" has a maintenance_exclusion ending {end}, after the end of extended support for GKE {minor} ({eoe}). GKE says you can't configure maintenance exclusions past that date, except as a temporary emergency measure.
fix: End the exclusion on or before {eoe} and schedule the minor upgrade inside it.

msg: Node pool "{name}" pins version {minor}, which left standard support on {eos} (extended support ends {eoe}).
fix: Upgrade the node pool with its control plane to {next}.

msg: Cluster "{name}" is on channel = "EXTENDED" without a min_master_version this file can resolve. The fee depends on the live minor: $0.50 per cluster per hour once that minor passes end of standard support.
fix: Pin min_master_version (or a google_container_engine_versions version_prefix) so the fee date is visible in review.
